newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia says in big GSM, DCS payphone deals.
newsitem.headline: Nokia says in big GSM, DCS payphone deals.

text.p: Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy said in a statement on Thursday it had delivered several thousands of wireless GSM or DCS payphones to customers in Thailand and South Africa.
"Nokia ... has delivered several thousands of wireless payphones to Thailand and South Africa," it said, adding the contracts were "the world's largest GSM/DCS 1800 wireless payphone deals".

Total Access Communication Public Company Limited (TAC) of Thailand had chosen Nokia's wireless payphones for its DCS 1800 network, it said. TAC had equipped taxis, buses, hotels and airport limousines with Nokia payphones, it said.

In South Africa, GSM-operator Mobile Telephone Networks (MTN), had installed Nokia payphones for example in trailers that can be moved to various locations for social gatherings or emergency situations, Nokia said.
It did not give the value of the contracts nor did it say when the wireless payphones had been delivered.
